process-based controls are associated with lower creativity when employees have high domain-relevant knowledge and that they are associated with higher creativity when employees have low domain-relevant.
the effects of the control system design on creativity depend on the level of the employees’ domain-relevant knowledge.

process-based control systems have an adverse effect on the creative performance of employees who are high in domain-relevant knowledge and a beneficial effect on the creative performances of employees who are low in domain-relevant knowl-edge.

the interaction between domain-relevant knowledge and the design of the control system on creativity.
the interaction between domain-relevant knowledge and control system design on creativity.
how control systems can be used to enhance the creative potential of organisations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of control design on creativity is contingent on the domain-relevant knowledge of employees.
the interaction between domain-relevant knowledge and control system design is an important determinant of the creativity of employees.
control system design can have a positive effect on creativity when domain-relevants knowledge is low, but can have a negative effect when domain-relevant is high.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
creativity is not always beneficial.
creativity is a complex phenomenon that is influenced by a variety of individual, group and organisational characteristics.
creativity is enhanced when employees have high domain-relevant knowledge and when the control system is not process-based.
The main takeaway from our work is that
control systems should be tailored to the level of domain-related knowledge that employees possess, as this has an important effect on creativity.
control system design can either increase or decrease employee creativity, depending on the level of employees’ domain-relevant knowledge.
control system design is not a one-size-fits-all solution for creativity.
